title: Quay.io images out of date
body:
Hello,

quay.io/buldah/stable is missing the latest releases (v1.44.0 and v1.43.2 at least). Not sure if this is expected or not, but wanted to raise awareness.

Thanks!

comments.body:
This is expected (at least in the sense of how the image builds are designed) because we pull builds from fedora stable repos there and these updates will not land in fedora stable for a while.

https://github.com/containers/image_build

There is also the other issue that the CI system there was shut off so there is no automation at the moment to build any images until someone has time to rework the entire CI system there
A friendly reminder that this issue had no activity for 30 days.
So how should users get the latest buildah images now? This used to be a reliable (and documented...) way to get the latest container-tools versions and has been changed without any announcement.
Please dont mark as stale (unless theres no intention for project to host images anymore - which would be a shame)
@cevich were you aware of this, and any chance of getting this back on-line?  Or at least get us some helpful pointers to do so?
Image_build is in progress of migration to the new GHA based ci. Thanks
@cevich and @timcoding1988, TYVM. Let me know if I can assist.  At one point years ago, I was publishing the images via a cron job.  If necessary for a stopgap, I could try to get that going again.

Thanks for taking on the migration @timcoding1988 

I recall the automation there and especially the scripts were anything but "easy" to understand (mostly my fault).  I tried to lay down a lot of comments, but so many things were just weird.  If you run into any massive 🤯 or can't figure some "WTF cevich?!?!?!" out, feel free to ping me 😄
Hopefully this is cured with: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/image_build/pull/62 which has just merged.

> Hopefully this is cured with: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/image_build/pull/62 which has just merged.

No not really, as noted above the image design uses packages from fedora stable and neither the latest podman,buildah,skopeo will be in fedora stable until f45 releases in a few months.

The PR just fixed the CI situation which is important. So we get new image rebuilds of podman 5.8 and buildah 1.43 but not latest unless we switch to f45 as base over there.

> No not really, as noted above the image design uses packages from fedora stable and neither the latest podman,buildah,skopeo will be in fedora stable until f45 releases in a few months.

yikes. I'm still not understanding, why the skopeo project is unable to produce eco system independent artifacts.

It would be an RFE to be sure, but since there's already a mechanism to deal with multiple "flavors" of image builds; Perhaps a new "future" flavor could be added wherein the podman-next (if that's still a thing) COPR is used; if not rawhide. Just a thought 🪙

> Perhaps a new "future" flavor could be added wherein the podman-next (if that's still a thing) COPR is used; if not rawhide. Just a thought

That is what the upstream image is used for which pulls from podman-next copr
